question: The religious festival of Ganesh Chaturthi is especially associated with which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• Ganesh Chaturthi is also known as **Vinayak Chaturthi **or** Vinayak Chaviti or ****Ganeshotsav.**
 
• It is a festival celebrated by followers of Hinduism.
 
• The festival celebrates Lord Ganesh as the God of New beginnings and the removal of obstacles.
 
• It is celebrated throughout India, especially in **Maharashtra **and **Goa.**
 
• Outside India, it is celebrated by the Hindu diaspora in New Zealand, Australia, Canada, and several other countries.
 
• The festival has been celebrated since the era of King Shivaji, the founder of the Maratha Empire.
